name: Optimal Workshop
description_en:
Optimal Workshop offers usability research and information-architecture testing, including card sorting, tree testing, prototypes and live sites.

Its current Starter plan bundles a limited number of launched studies with unlimited seats and responses; participant recruitment and AI data conditions must be assessed separately.
description_zh:
Optimal Workshop 提供可用性研究及信息架构测试，包括卡片分类、树测试、原型和线上网站。

当前 Starter 将有限的新研究数量与无限席位/回答结合；参与者招募及 AI 数据条件需要另行评估。

core_features.explanation_zh: 树测试接受手工或导入层级、任务和招募链接，报告成功率、耗时与路径。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Test the label and structure before visual polish
sections.title_zh: 视觉润色前测试标签和结构
sections.en:
Optimal’s tree-testing page isolates navigation in a plain-text hierarchy. Build or import the structure, write realistic information-finding tasks, invite your own participants or use recruitment services, then inspect success, time and paths. Because visual layout is removed, a tree test investigates how labels and hierarchy support finding information; it does not test the complete rendered interface.

For a hypothetical help-center redesign, ask where someone would look to change a billing address without repeating a menu label. Compare wrong turns and direct success, then revise ambiguous groupings. Card sorting is complementary: it explores how people group content, while tree testing evaluates a proposed structure. Keep the tested hierarchy and task version with the results. A navigation finding alone is not proof of accessibility compliance or improved revenue.
sections.zh:
Optimal 树测试页以纯文字层级隔离导航。可建立或导入结构、编写真实信息查找任务、邀请自有参与者或使用招募服务，再检查成功率、耗时和路径。去掉视觉布局后，树测试研究的是标签和层级怎样支持查找，不测试完整渲染界面。

以帮助中心改版为假设，可询问用户会到哪里修改账单地址，但不重复菜单标签。比较错误转向和直接成功，再调整含糊分组。卡片分类与其互补：前者探索人们怎样分组内容，树测试评估已提出的结构。结果应附测试层级和任务版本。导航发现本身不能证明符合可访问性标准或提升收入。

sections.title_en: Count launched studies, not only responses
sections.title_zh: 除了回答数，也要计算启动的研究数
sections.en:
The current price page lists Starter at $199 per month billed annually, including five studies launched per year. It includes unlimited seats, unlimited participant responses per study and all listed tools/study types; more studies require additional bundles. Enterprise is custom with tailored study bundles and additional security/admin support. The checkout currency, explicit annual invoice and extra-study bundle prices were not captured.

“All tools” includes prototype/live-site/mobile testing, card/tree/first-click methods, surveys and qualitative analysis, but a five-study entitlement is not unlimited research. Plan how separate variants, iterations and launches count before committing to a year. The pricing page does not offer a clearly quantified permanent free plan; “Try Free” links do not establish ongoing free use. A real account was not created to test study counting or plan enforcement.
sections.zh:
现行价格页列出 Starter 每月 $199、按年计费，包含每年启动五个研究。它提供无限席位、每研究无限参与者回答，以及所有列出的工具/研究类型；更多研究需购买附加包。Enterprise 定制，提供定制研究包和额外安全/管理支持。结账货币、明确年付发票和额外研究包价格未捕获。

“全部工具”包括原型/线上网站/移动测试、卡片/树/首次点击、问卷及定性分析，但五个研究权益并非无限研究。年付前需规划不同变体、迭代和启动如何计数。价格页没有明确量化的永久免费套餐，“Try Free” 链接不证明长期免费使用。本研究未创建账户测试研究计数或套餐限制。

sections.title_en: Recruitment credits have an expiry and a quality window
sections.title_zh: 招募点数有到期时间和质量反馈窗口
sections.en:
Pricing separates on-demand recruitment from platform usage. Standard Recruitment is listed at one credit per participant; managed recruitment depends on requirements and a quote. A response allowance does not supply free recruited participants. The reviewed terms say purchased participant credits expire 12 months after purchase or immediately when no current paid subscription is maintained. They are nonrefundable.

The terms also require reporting a suspected bad-quality participant within five days, after which replacement or noncounting rules apply under stated conditions. Specialist audiences may require a niche request. Before launching, budget the actual audience, screeners and incentives and record the feedback deadline; no rate per credit, fulfillment time, niche incidence or replacement transaction was tested.
sections.zh:
价格页将按需招募与平台使用分开。Standard Recruitment 列为每人一点，托管招募按需求报价。回答额度不包含免费招来的参与者。已读条款说购买的参与者点数在购买后 12 个月到期；如果不再维持有效付费订阅，则立即到期，且不可退款。

条款还要求在五天内反馈疑似低质量参与者，然后按条件适用替换或不计入余额规则。专业人群可能需要细分招募请求。启动前应预算实际人群、筛选和激励并记录反馈截止时间；每点单价、完成时间、细分人群符合比例或替换交易均未测试。

sections.title_en: Optional AI does not mean no future internal model training
sections.title_zh: AI 可选不等于未来内部模型永不训练
sections.en:
The legal center’s AI Policy says AI interacts with customer data and features can be disabled on request. It says Optimal does not currently train AI models and will not share customer data to train third-party models, while reserving the possibility of using aggregated/anonymized submitted data to train Optimal models tied to specific features. Those statements should be kept together rather than shortened into an unconditional “no training” promise.

The policy describes AWS infrastructure and Bedrock/LLMs and says outputs should be vetted by people. Pricing lists AI transcripts, summaries, themes, sentiment and redaction. Treat generated themes as hypotheses grounded in source responses: inspect counterexamples and clips before assigning a recommendation. No model accuracy, redaction coverage, security certification or actual disable request was verified.
sections.zh:
法律中心 AI 政策说 AI 会接触客户数据，功能可按请求关闭。它表示 Optimal 当前不训练 AI 模型，不会将客户数据交给第三方训练，同时保留以后使用提交数据的聚合/匿名形式训练特定产品功能内部模型的可能。这些陈述应一起保留，不能压缩成无条件“不训练”。

政策描述 AWS 基础设施及 Bedrock/LLM，并说输出需人工检查。价格页列出 AI 转录、摘要、主题、情绪倾向和遮盖。生成主题应被视为基于原始回答的假设：形成建议前需检查反例及片段。模型准确率、遮盖覆盖、安全认证和实际关闭请求均未验证。

sections.title_en: A focused IA round can be the evaluation unit
sections.title_zh: 以一轮聚焦信息架构研究作为评估单元
sections.en:
The reviewed terms describe fixed terms renewing for the same duration unless either party gives at least 30 days notice, fees paid in advance and generally no refunds. Actual order forms may set specific conditions. Before a trial or purchase, confirm study counting, exports, retention and whether the intended recruitment remains usable when the subscription ends.

A practical pilot would use one navigation question, a stable hierarchy and realistic participants, then trace each proposed change to task-level evidence. This is an editorial evaluation method, not a study already run. The current draft documents the research workflow and commercial constraints without proving sample representativeness, actual interface compatibility, AI correctness or business outcomes.
sections.zh:
已读条款描述固定期限在任一方至少提前 30 天通知前会按相同期限续期，费用预付且通常不退款。实际订单可能另有具体条件。试用或购买前应确认研究计数、导出、保留，以及订阅结束后拟用招募是否仍可访问。

实用试点可围绕一个导航问题、稳定层级和真实目标参与者展开，再将每个调整建议追溯到任务级证据。这是编辑评估方法，并非已经执行的研究。现稿记录研究流程与商业条件，未证明样本代表性、实际界面兼容、AI 正确性或业务结果。

research_gaps.zh: 未执行研究、招募订单、Figma 导入、AI 输出、遮盖、可访问性或取消测试。
